profile.name: Josh Inglis
profile.writeup:
Josh Inglis has quickly established himself as one of Australia’s most dynamic wicketkeeper-batters, combining explosive strokeplay with sharp work behind the stumps. Born in England, the right-hander represents Australia across formats and has emerged as a formidable force in T20 cricket.

Inglis made his Test debut against Sri Lanka in 2025 and marked the occasion with a century, before producing a memorable 120 against England at the ICC Champions Trophy. His aggressive batting has also made him a key figure in Australia’s T20I setup, where he has registered two centuries.

After making his IPL debut with Punjab Kings in 2025, Inglis joined Lucknow Super Giants for IPL 2026 and made an immediate impact. Featuring in just five matches, he amassed 266 runs at a phenomenal strike rate of 186.01, including three half-centuries. His standout performance came against Chennai Super Kings, when he smashed 85 off just 33 balls, while he followed it up with a blistering 60 off 29 balls against Rajasthan Royals.

With his fearless approach, ability to clear the boundaries and versatility at the top of the order, Inglis has quickly become an exciting addition to the Lucknow Super Giants batting unit.
